n=19
orig=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
marks=[(2,6),(3,5),(3,7),(3,13),(4,6),(4,12),(4,14),(5,13),(9,8),(10,7),(10,9),(11,8),(11,14),(12,13),(12,15),(13,3),(13,14),(14,2),(14,4),(15,3)]
for r,c in marks: orig[r][c]=3
centers=[(3,6,8),(4,13,4),(12,14,1),(14,3,2)]
for r,c,v in centers: orig[r][c]=v
out=[row[:] for row in orig]
# draw row rays first, stop at 3 except the source's adjacent arms; empty cross column is a hole but not a stop
for r,c,v in centers:
 for dc in (-1,1):
  j=c+dc
  while 0<=j<n:
   if orig[r][j]==3:
    if abs(j-c)==1: j+=dc; continue
    break
   if j!=8: out[r][j]=v
   j+=dc
# draw column rays
for r,c,v in centers:
 for dr in (-1,1):
  i=r+dr
  while 0<=i<n:
   if orig[i][c]==3:
    if abs(i-r)==1: i+=dr; continue
    break
   out[i][c]=v
   i+=dr
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
